extraction: scripts/build_tables_1_3_inputs.py --workspace <original-workspace>; never required for offline reproduction
source_sha256_timing: Each source is hashed from the same bytes before parsing/extraction. Originals are read only.

exports.selection: All 240 rows from each platform's _e10/runs/e10/matrix.csv; no GLM, historical E8, smoke, or pooled conditions.
exports.batch_rationale: E10 B-v4 DeepSeek component controls are the current manuscript Table I source.

field_mapping.export_calls: P3_export_calls, independently counted from scenario target-tool events

exports.selection: All 360 rows per platform from _e13/runs/e13/matrix.csv; natural/full x B0/B1/B2 x both scenarios x fixed 30 tasks.
exports.batch_rationale: e13-rfull-1 official natural-layout and controlled-full-content batch; excludes all prechecks and smoke.

field_mapping.first_t/first_k1/first_k2/first_k3: P2_exposure_* independently checked in first actual request memory block with task-specific IDs and rc=0 tokens
field_mapping.all_requests_full: P2_full_exposure_all_requests independently checked over every captured request
field_mapping.executed/export_calls: scenario target-tool events, agrees with P3_verdict/P3_export_calls

exports.batch_rationale: Contemporaneous e19x_v1/x-main eight cells; never substitutes E17 executions or E19q retrieval counts.

field_mapping.platform/scenario/task_id/layout/query_m: input_config identity fields, w and m_count
field_mapping.retrieved_component_count: number of nonempty whitespace-normalized full component match_text values contained in joined search_results.content
field_mapping.first_full: all full component match_text values contained in first actual request's PAST_CONVERSATIONS block
field_mapping.executed/export_calls: events where scenario target tool, executed=true and result.status=EXPORTED
field_mapping.export_attempts: scenario target tool events with executed=true

validation.omissions: No raw prompts, response text, credentials, account configurations, or business text are exported. Raw evidence is read locally only.
